mapper.sql: id, document_id, event_type, payload, status, retry_count, max_retry, last_error, created_at, next_retry_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_outbox (document_id, event_type, payload, status, retry_count, max_retry, last_error, created_at, next_retry_at) VALUES (#{documentId}, #{eventType}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{maxRetry}, #{lastError}, NOW(), #{nextRetryAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM knowledge_outbox WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM knowledge_outbox WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND next_retry_at <= #{beforeTime} ORDER BY next_retry_at ASC LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_outbox SET status = 'PROCESSING' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE knowledge_outbox SET status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE id = #{id}
